lesson.title: Read an optional nested name
lesson.summary: Complete profileName(user). Read user.profile.name when available; return "Unknown" if user, profile, or name is null or undefined. Preserve an existing empty name. Inputs follow this object shape when present; do not modify them.
explanation: Optional chaining uses ?. to stop a property lookup when the value immediately before it is null or undefined.
Each possibly missing boundary needs its own protection. user?.profile?.name handles a missing user and a missing profile.
The ?? operator supplies a fallback only for null or undefined. It keeps an empty string; || would replace that empty string too.
Combine the guarded lookup with the fallback for this exercise. An existing name is returned without changing the object.
Optional chaining does not catch every error. It does not make an undeclared variable safe or suppress an exception thrown inside another operation.

quiz.question: The stored name is an empty string. What changes if you replace ?? "Unknown" with || "Unknown"?
choices: Nothing; both operators only handle null and undefined.
The object’s name field is permanently deleted.
The empty name is replaced by Unknown instead of being preserved.
quiz.explanation: Empty text is falsy for || but is neither null nor undefined for ??.
